record.field: Antibacterial agents used to treat acute and chronic odontogenic infections, periapical abscesses, and surgical prophylaxis.
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs and pain management medicines for post-operative dental pain, pulpal pain, and facial neuralgia.
Topical mouthwashes, chlorhexidine solutions, and periodontal irrigation solutions for plaque control and gingival inflammation.
Infiltration and nerve block anesthetic cartridges (Lignocaine, Articaine, Mepivacaine, Bupivacaine) with or without vasoconstrictor.
Topical oral mucosal ointments and pastes for aphthous ulcers, lichen planus, and post-endodontic inflammation.
Coagulation accelerators, tranexamic acid, and local styptics for post-extraction bleeding management.
Medications for oral candidiasis, denture stomatitis, and angular cheilitis (Clotrimazole, Nystatin, Fluconazole).
High-fluoride pastes, calcium remineralizing agents, and vitamin complexes supporting bone and tissue regeneration.
